sources.title: GitHub - Sisyphe-lee/opd-baseline-repro: Reproducible THUNLP/OPD ...
sources.snippet: This repository is a thin, reproducible overlay for the response-only OPD baseline from THUNLP/OPD. It pins upstream code, installs the tested runtime, downloads the exact student and teacher, validates multi-GPU execution, and provides separate three-step and full-training launchers.
